other_failure_modes.name: Destructive categorical encoding
other_failure_modes.description: The agent uses `pd.to_numeric(..., errors='coerce')` on object columns. This blindly replaces any non-numeric string categories with NaN, effectively destroying all categorical information rather than properly encoding it (e.g., via LabelEncoding, One-Hot Encoding, or native categorical types).

other_failure_modes.name: Data leakage in cross-validation
other_failure_modes.description: Imputation statistics (like the median) are computed on the entire training set before performing the cross-validation split. This leaks information from the validation folds into the training folds during the CV loop.

summary: The agent sets up a baseline LightGBM model with 5-fold cross-validation but severely damages the dataset by coercing all object columns to numeric, effectively wiping out string categorical features. Furthermore, the solution lacks any feature engineering, evaluates using only a single metric, and introduces data leakage in the cross-validation loop by calculating imputation medians prior to the fold splits.
